sloka: स एष रामस् त्वाम् योद्धुम् राजन् समभिवर्तते ।यः च एष दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शुद्ध जाम्बू नद प्रभः ॥६-२८-२२॥।।
transliteration: sa eṣa rāmas tvām yoddhum rājan samabhivartate ।yaḥ ca eṣa dakṣiṇe pārśve śuddha jāmbū nada prabhaḥ ॥6-28-22॥।।

translations.english: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
translations.hindi: जो अपने बाणों से आकाश को छेद सकते हे ऑर पंव ता को विदीर्ण कर सकते हैं, जिनका क्रोध, मृत्यु के समान ऑर पराक्रम इन्द्र की तरह दे
